instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Ana Ruiz. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Ana Ruiz. Do not return images or details of anyone.
Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

said: I confirmed Ana Ruiz is registered as a known face. The camera list did not come back with usable details, so I could not check the Living Room camera. Fair Hours only uses cameras that cover a door. Does the Living Room camera only cover the door Ana uses (entrance, gate or hallway), and not the inside of the home? Also, do you want the default tolerance of 10 minutes, and any agreed terms such as a minimum visit length or rounding? I will take the period from the dates printed on the bill.
reply: Yes, she knows the door camera recognises faces and that we may use it to check hours.

said: Thanks. To be sure: does the Living Room camera only cover a door (the one Ana uses to come in and leave)? Yes or no. If it films the inside of the room, I must leave it out. Tolerance stays 10 minutes unless you say otherwise.
reply: Oh, the living room camera doesn't cover a door. Use the Front Door camera instead.

instruction: Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-03 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Ana Ruiz and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.
